subject: english
objectives: 依 yes-no 問句開頭的動詞形成肯定或否定簡答。
把名詞主詞換成正確代名詞，並保持人稱、時態與事實一致。

sections.title: 簡答沿用問句中的 be 動詞或助動詞
sections.content: Is Tina home? 回答 Yes, she is. 或 No, she isn't.；Does Leo cook? 回答 Yes, he does. 或 No, he doesn't.。簡答不必重複主要動詞，但助動詞必須和問句同一套。

sections.title: 過去、未來與情態助動詞也要對應
sections.content: Did they leave? 可答 Yes, they did.；Will Amy come? 可答 No, she won't.；Can Ben swim? 可答 Yes, he can.。不要因中文意思相近就把 did、will、can 互換。

sections.title: 完成式簡答使用 have 或 has
sections.content: Has Mia finished? 的回答是 Yes, she has. 或 No, she hasn't.。Have the buses left? 則使用 they have 或 they haven't；完成式簡答不改用 do。

sections.title: 代名詞與肯否定都必須符合事實
sections.content: 問句主詞 the students 在簡答中換成 they，your mother 對聽者而言通常換成 she。先確認實際答案是肯定還是否定，再選助動詞；不能只看到 Yes 就固定接 does。

workedExamples.prompt: Is Grace busy? Yes, ___. (she is / she does / Grace is busy)
workedExamples.why: Is 開頭的 be 問句用 is 回答，Grace 可換成 she，所以 Yes, she is 正確。she does 換錯助動詞，完整重複句也不是題目要求的簡答。

workedExamples.prompt: Did the boys win? No, ___. (they didn't / they don't / he didn't)
workedExamples.why: 問句的 did 決定短答使用 didn't，複數 boys 則換成 they。don't 會改成現在，he 也不符合複數主詞。

workedExamples.prompt: Has Nora arrived? No, ___. (she hasn't / she doesn't / Nora not)
workedExamples.why: Has Nora arrived 要以 has 回應；否定縮寫是 hasn't，因此 No, she hasn't 正確。doesn't 不屬於完成式。

misconceptions.belief: 所有肯定簡答都寫 Yes, I do.。
misconceptions.whyWrong: 助動詞必須依原問句選 is、did、can、has 等。
misconceptions.correction: 先圈出問句第一個動詞，再沿用到簡答。

misconceptions.belief: the girls 在簡答中可換成 she。
misconceptions.correction: 使用 Yes, they are. 等對應形式。

misconceptions.belief: Did he call? 可以回答 No, he doesn't.。
misconceptions.whyWrong: doesn't 是現在式，與 did 的過去時間不一致。

misconceptions.belief: Has she eaten? 應回答 Yes, she does.。
misconceptions.whyWrong: 問句使用完成式 has，不是一般現在式 do。

checks.prompt: Are the doors open 的肯定簡答是什麼？
Can Sam drive 的否定簡答是什麼？
Have Amy and Mia left 的主詞代名詞是什麼？
